Today, we release the weights of a new and improved Le Chonk, advancing the open frontier for agentic coding and cybersecurity.

💻 Built to build: Le Chonk ranks #1 on @cognition’s FrontierCode among open models, and sets a new benchmark for Pareto efficiency on @artificialanalysis.

🛡 Built to defend: State-of-the-art in cyberdefense, put through the paces by the world's leading cyber vendors, including @CrowdStrike, @cloudflare, @rubrik, @zscaler, and others.

Built for sovereignty: Make it yours. Download the weights on @huggingface , customize it with Mistral Forge, and deploy it wherever you need it.

What does real-time transcription look like in a live setting?

🎙 We used Voxtral Transcribe 3 at AI Engineer Paris to capture every main-stage talk in real time. We boosted accuracy with context biasing, feeding the model speaker names and technical terms from the conference agenda..

Transcribing speech is one thing. Knowing when someone is done speaking is another.

🎙 Voxtral 3’s end-of-turn detection helps developers identify when a user has finished speaking, making it easier to build responsive voice interactions without relying on science alone.

Can Mistral Large 4 find a critical vulnerability, prove it and fix it? We tested it on a recent Django CVE.

133 agents map the code, hunt for flaws, test attack scenarios and confirm the bug. Then Le Chonk patches it.

Triage, repro, patch. Shown at 90x speed.

Mistral Large 4 joins the model lineup on Open Math OS.

1.05T open weights, 1M context, live today for approved teams.

Open Math OS is a research workspace where mathematicians and AI agents work on shared projects, built only on open models so the community can inspect and run them, and with the community in control of its own data. 

More open frontier models in the lineup means more choice for every team.

We tasked Mistral Large 4 with creating a real-time, 3D tracker of the roughly 19,000 satellites and debris fragments orbiting Earth. 

The model built a working app, tested it like a user, made it fast, and passed strict verification.
